build_RefMLP: build a RefMLP module to encode tokenized reference images into a list of reference encodings for DiT
build_Ref2DMLP: build a Ref2DMLP module to encode 2D plucker images with optional SIREN and conv encoder into tokens
build_RefBlock: build a RefBlock with LayerNorm and FeedForward layers supporting skip connections and GEGLU activation
test_RefMLP: test the RefMLP module by passing a random tensor of shape (B, N, D) and checking output shapes
build_FeedForward: build a FeedForward module with optional GEGLU activation, dropout, and configurable inner dimension multiplier
